channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: Claude Misused for Weapons Research
item.description: On the latest episode of the early edition of Balance of power, David Gura and Christina Ruffini speak with Mike Shepard, Bloomberg Senior Editor for Technology and Strategic Industries; Rick Davis, Partner at Stonecourt Capital and Bloomberg Politics Contributor & Jeanne Sheehan Zaino, Democracy Visiting Fellow at Harvard Kennedy School's Ash Center and Bloomberg Politics Contributor. They also speak with Nicholas Burns, former US Ambassador to China and NATO, and Brigadier General Leland Blanchard II, Interim Commanding General of the District of Columbia National Guard. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: How Larry Ellison Built His Empire
item.description: Expanding from database software into artificial intelligence and media, Larry Ellison is placing his biggest bets yet. Bloomberg Originals explores what drives the 82-year-old tech billionaire. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Inflation Rises, Wealth Transfers, Case For Social Security | Bloomberg Money 9/11/2026
item.description: Bloomberg Money takes the pulse of your financial life, powered by the reporting of our global newsroom. Today's guests: Centerview Partners Senior Counselor, Council on Foreign Relations President Emeritus, and Former Advisor to Colin Powell & President H.W. Bush Richard Haass and Morgan Stanley Wealth Management Chief Economic Strategist Ellen Zentner. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Hot US Inflation Pushes Fed Toward Rate Hike That Trump Opposes
item.description: Odds of a rate increase at next week’s meeting have shot up.
item.dc:creator: Catarina Saraiva

item.title: US Debt Is a National Security Issue, Haass Says
item.description: Richard Haass, senior counselor with Centerview Partners, president emeritus for the Council on Foreign Relations, and former advisor to Colin Powell and President George H.W. Bush, says America's $40 trillion national debt, is not just a fiscal problem but a national security concern. He speaks with Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Money." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Canada’s Insurance Policy Against Trump
item.description: Is Canada becoming the EU’s 28th state rather than the US’ 51st? That’s more meme than reality, but they are building a hedge against America, says Bloomberg Opinion columnist Lionel Laurent. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Some 9/11 Families Use Ceremony to Push Trump on Saudi Arabia
item.description: Some family members of those killed on Sept. 11, 2001, used the 25th anniversary ceremony to call on President Donald Trump to hold Saudi Arabia accountable for its alleged complicity in the US’s worst terrorist attack.
item.dc:creator: Sonya Dymova

item.title: Trump’s ‘Golden Age’ Confronts Economic Angst That Threatens GOP
item.description: The Republican faithful, gathered in arena hallways and hotel ballrooms during this week’s midterm convention, projected confidence they had a good story to tell on the economy.
item.dc:creator: Josh Wingrove

item.title: India Hosts BRICS Leaders' Summit 2026
item.description: India is hosting the BRICS leaders’ summit in New Delhi over the weekend, bringing together leaders from major emerging economies. Bloomberg's Haslinda Amin is in Mumbai with a preview of what to expect. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trump Marks 9/11 Anniversary at Pentagon With Iran War Defense (Remarks)
item.description: President Donald Trump joins officials - including Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, Joint Chiefs of Staff Chairman Gen. Dan Caine - at a commemoration held at the Pentagon 25 years after the September 11, 2001 attacks. Trump, saluting servicemembers, says that Iran will never get a nuclear weapon, and emphasizes an American spirit "to endure and preview and to win" in the years since 9/11. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth also used part of his remarks to address the war with Iran, saying "We control the strait. We will finish this fight." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Russia Sanctions Bill Scheduled for a House Vote Next Week
item.description: A Russia sanctions bill overwhelmingly passed by the US Senate last month will receive a vote in the House next week, a person familiar with the plans said.
item.dc:creator: Erik Wasson

item.title: Houthi Gains Leave MBS With Few Good Options in Yemen
item.description: As the Iran-backed Houthis gain ground in Yemen and strike Saudi Arabia’s oil infrastructure, the kingdom faces a stark choice: escalate a military campaign that’s for years failed to defeat the militants or tolerate greater rebel leverage over a Red Sea route that’s become increasingly important to its oil exports.
item.dc:creator: Simon Marks, Peter Martin and Veena Ali-Khan

item.title: Hassett Says Trump $5,000 Checks Can Be Fiscally Responsible
item.description: White House National Economic Council Director Kevin Hassett played down concerns that President Donald Trump’s proposal to send $5,000 checks to every adult US citizen would add to worries about historically high government borrowing.
item.dc:creator: Michael Sasso

item.title: NEC’s Kevin Hassett on 9/11, Inflation, Trump’s $5,000 Payments
item.description: National Economic Council Director Kevin Hassett says inflation is “clearly decelerating” over the last three months as he discusses the US August CPI report. Hassett also talks about respecting Federal Reserve independence on interest-rate decisions and the potential path to President Donald Trump’s suggestion of a $5,000 payment if Republicans keep control of the House and Senate in the midterm elections. Hassett also reflects on his personal experiences on September 11, 2001. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trump Marks 9/11 Anniversary at Pentagon With Iran War Defense
item.description: President Donald Trump defended the war in Iran during a Pentagon ceremony marking the 25th anniversary of the Sept. 11, 2001 attacks, tying the conflict to the US’s decades-long fight against terrorism.
item.dc:creator: Kate Sullivan and Courtney Subramanian

item.title: Germany to Approve Small Boxer Batches as Large Orders Languish
item.description: Germany is planning to obtain additional Boxer armored vehicles for specialized use, but has not yet firmed up plans for larger military orders of the platforms, which defense firms like Rheinmetall AG and KNDS NV rely on for outlooks and valuations.
item.dc:creator: Michael Nienaber and Laura Alviž

item.title: UK Rejects Assisted Dying in Second Attempt at Passing the Law
item.description: UK lawmakers narrowly voted to shelve a bill to legalize assisted dying in England and Wales during a quiet Friday sitting at which a lukewarm government stance tipped votes in favor of opponents to the law.
item.dc:creator: Rose Henderson

item.title: Green Leader Polanski Sets Up UK Election Showdown With Burnham
item.description: Green Party leader Zack Polanski’s decision to seek an open UK Parliament seat sets the stage for a dramatic test of both Prime Minister Andy Burnham’s popularity and his own.
item.dc:creator: Chloe Chaplain

item.title: Iran Turns to BRICS Summit as US War Deepens Its Isolation
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian arrived in New Delhi on Friday for a BRICS summit marked by deep divisions as the war involving Iran, the US and Israel enters a dangerous new phase.
item.dc:creator: Dan Strumpf and Sudhi Ranjan Sen

item.title: Gulf States Weigh Rare Meeting With Iran Next Week on Hormuz
item.description: A six-member bloc of Gulf states is weighing a meeting with Iranian officials next week to discuss the future of the Strait of Hormuz, people familiar with the matter said, in what would be the first gathering with the Islamic Republic since war erupted more than six months ago.
item.dc:creator: Fiona MacDonald and Alex Dooler
